How it works

How Deal Pal works.

Shoppers share what they find, and local stores post their own deals too.

  1. 1

    Spot

    Spot a clearance deal at your local store.

  2. 2

    Share

    Take a photo of the item, add item information and share with your local community.

  3. 3

    Browse

    View posts from other Deal Pal users and local stores within your set geographical radius.

  4. 4

    Save

    Help both yourself and other Deal Pal users save money and time.

Inside the app

Easy access to all the best deals around you.

Four screens, swipe to see each one →

Deal feed

Freshest firstSorted by distance, then by how new the post is. No sponsored posts, ever.

Radius map

Your area, your callPick 10, 25, 50 or 100 km and only see deals worth the trip.

Sold Out

No wasted tripsIf items are gone, stores and users can mark deals as sold out instantly.

Gold stars

Thanks you can countNeighbours star the posts that saved them money. Reach 100 stars to become a Deal Legend.
